Additionally, she will be finishing her Masters in Integrative Medicine at George Washington University in the spring of 2022. providers.bio: Melissa is a Certified Nurse Midwife, wife, and mother of eight children. She graduated from Frontier Nursing University in 1999 with a certification in Midwifery and from Case Western Reserve University with a Master’s in Nursing in 2002. After completing medical management training with FEMM in 2019, she continued her education with a fellowship in Restorative Reproductive Medicine with RHM Gynecology/ Dr Nicholas Kongoasa of Atlanta. Melissa is currently the primary midwife with Southern Illinois Midwifery in Carbondale, IL. providers.title: Certified FEMM Instructor, Certified Athletic Trainer
providers.bio: Mairead is a certified athletic trainer and a certified FEMM instructor. Her education in sports medicine combined with her work in women’s health provides her with a unique toolkit to help guide active teens and women of all ages. She is passionate about teaching women how to use fertility awareness and support their hormones by applying their unique cycle data to their lifestyle. As a competitive Irish dancer for 15 years, Mairead understands the desire for women to stay active and healthy after “retiring” from a sport. She loves to support women with the tools they need to understand their body and sync their lifestyle, healthy habits, and exercise routine with the phases of their cycle. Her workshops include the FEMM protocol and classes on cycle syncing, especially as it pertains to exercise. Mairead sees fertility awareness as a necessity for all women and advocates for theology of the body & body literacy presentations in both high schools and colleges.

providers.name: Rachel Meyer
providers.bio: I am a SymptoPro teacher-trainer and an all-around NFP enthusiast and advocate. I have been using NFP for all of my ten years of marriage and teaching SymptoPro since 2018. I learned the Creighton, Billings and Marquette methods as a client before learning SymptoPro, and I am particularly interested in teaching women who have a more serious need to avoid pregnancy or have not had success avoiding pregnancy with other NFP methods. I have enjoyed working with women of various cultural backgrounds and am happy to teach women of any religious faith or none. For me, teaching NFP is a ministry and not a business, and I don’t turn away clients who are unable to pay for a class. Besides teaching SymptoPro, I am a homeschooling mother of four and actively involved in Catholic parish life as a lay Dominican. I have a degree in Chemical Engineering from the University of Notre Dame and my husband is a physicist, so I like to approach fertility awareness from a scientific perspective.

Certified by FEMM as a medical consultant, Anna specializes in Restorative Reproductive Medicine, focusing on identifying and treating the root causes of her patients’ health concerns. She creates personalized treatment plans using holistic and evidence-based protocols for conditions such as abnormal menstrual cycles, PMS, infertility, PCOS, fatigue, weight issues, thyroid disorders, and anxiety/depression. Anna earned her BSN from The Catholic University of America and spent six years working as a registered nurse. providers.name: Emma Goff
providers.bio: I’m passionate about helping clients understand their fertility in a way that feels grounded, supportive, and connected to whole-body wellness. I love walking alongside women and couples as they learn to make sense of their cycles, notice what their bodies are communicating, and apply SymptoPro in a way that fits their real lives, not just ideal charts or perfect routines. I was drawn to this work through my own experience of learning to track my cycle and realizing how much clarity and confidence can come from truly understanding your body. That curiosity grew into a deep appreciation for cycle literacy as a practical, empowering tool, and a desire to support others in learning it with guidance and care. My teaching style is calm, relational, and paced to the person in front of me. I value live, personal instruction and ongoing connection, and I work best with clients who appreciate a supportive, low-pressure learning space where questions are welcome and confidence builds over time. I work with clients both online and in person. I live in Charleston, South Carolina with my husband and our two children. If you’re curious about whether we’d be a good fit for learning SymptoPro together, I offer free inquiry sessions and would love to connect.

Two years later, my FertilityCare Practitioner identified symptoms of low progesterone by looking at my chart. She sent me to a NaPro doctor, who prescribed progesterone. After two years of successfully avoiding pregnancy, including being fertile on our honeymoon, we were ready to achieve pregnancy! With progesterone support, we achieved and maintained pregnancy. Our beautiful daughter was born on February 6, 2017. I wanted to focus my time and energy at home, but I also desired to help other women like my Practitioner helped me. providers.title: Occupational Therapist, Marquette Method Certified Professional
providers.bio: Theresa is board-certified by the National Board Certification in Occupational Therapy and a Certified Professional Marquette Method NFP Instructor. She has a passion for women’s health and fertility, as well as optimizing health through an understanding of cycles and charting. She earned her BA in philosophy and Catholic theology from Thomas Aquinas College in 2008, and went on to get a Masters of Science in Occupational Therapy through Grand Valley State University in Michigan in 2018. She has done training in various clinical settings, including inpatient rehabilitation, home health, and pediatric care, and became board-certified in 2020. She has since been excited to unite her love of women’s health with her clinical expertise in OT by becoming a Marquette Method fertility educator. She has assisted women in coming off birth control, navigating postpartum and breastfeeding, and through other special circumstances such as miscarriage, and managing PCOS symptoms.

providers.name: Alice Romijn
providers.title: SymptoPro Instructor
providers.bio: Hi there! I'm Alice and I am here to help you make sense of your cycles and prevent or achieve pregnancy naturally. I grew up in the Netherlands and came to Australia when I was 21. I'm late 20s now and enjoying life with my husband and our cat. We also regularly welcome foster cats and kittens into our home. I first learned about fertility awareness when I was about 20 after I was put on hormonal birth control to combat PMS. It didn't work. I gave up after 2 months because not only had I had some constant PMS symptoms, I also did not feel right taking medicine every day to turn off a vital body function just to avoid discomfort. I still have terrible PMS at times but working with a naturopath and practicing fertility awareness so that I know when to expect PMS help a lot! After this brief experience on the pill I knew that I wanted a better option once I was looking for birth control. I was uncomfortable with any foreign devices inserted in my body and did not want to accept any of the side effects of other traditional methods, so when I heard about fertility awareness I just knew that this was for me and I learned as much about it as I could. Over the years I have learned several methods of fertility awareness, but Symptopro landed on top. Do you want to see how the method can work in your life? Work with me and find out! Location: Melbourne VIC (3138) Teaching in person and online Instagram: @cyclicalfertility

providers.name: Mike & Cindy Leonard
providers.title: SymptoPro Instructors
providers.practice_name: FertilityCare Center of the Diocese of Phoenix
providers.bio: Mike and Cindy Leonard have been married nearly 40 years and have five grown children who Cindy enjoyed homeschooling while also coordinating and teaching Science for many years in grade schools. Mike was often their coach for various sports as well as cubmaster for many years. Cindy and Mike enjoy hiking, biking and sailing together, but Mike definitely leads the pack as an outdoor enthusiast and has his sights set on the Appalachian Trail in the summer of 2018 after he retires from his IT career. Cindy is a trained catechist for the Catechesis of the Good Shepherd program and built the atria and directed that program at St. Agnes School in Phoenix for many years. Cindy has taught Northwest Family Service’s SymptoPro NFP method with her husband, Mike, for nearly 38 years and since 2007 has directed the Office of NFP for the Diocese of Phoenix, where NFP is a required course for marriage preparation. Cindy also co-developed and coordinates the Diocese of Phoenix teen leadership program for remote marriage preparation: Catholic Academy for Life Leadership. Cindy has an active position on the National NFP Advisory Board for the NFP Program in the Secretariat of Laity, Marriage, Family Life and Youth of the USCCB where she assists Diocesan NFP Coordinators in the USCCB Endorsement Process.

providers.title: Certified Billings Ovulation Method® Instructor
providers.bio: Ana received a master’s degree from the Pontifical John Paul II Institute for Marriage and Family. In her desire to help married couples learn NFP to embrace the fullness of graces in their sacramental marriage, Ana became a Billings Ovulation Method® (BOM) certified instructor and has taught the method since 2011. providers.bio: After receiving a National Merit Scholarship, Dr. Damon Cudihy graduated from Florida State University, in 1999 with honors earning a Bachelor’s degree in both biology and Spanish. He subsequently studied medicine at the University of Florida where he earned a Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree in 2003. During his second year of medical school, he was awarded a Health Professions Scholarship and commission in the U.S. Army’s Medical Services Corps. His postgraduate medical training began at the San Antonio Uniformed Services Health Education Consortium (SAUSHEC), where he completed 2 years of specialty training in Obstetrics and Gynecology. He went on to fulfill his military service obligation as a Field Surgeon during which he volunteered for an overseas deployment in July of 2006. In Iraq, Dr. (Captain) Cudihy served as Battalion Surgeon where his duties included providing medical care to hundreds of Iraqi civilians during various medical missions.

She works with couples/women who need to become acquainted with their bodies, recognize their fertility as a sign of health and wellness, and seek medical treatment if their charting suggests an underlying condition.

providers.name: Dr. Danielle Davis
providers.title: SymptoPro Instructor
providers.bio: Hello! I’m Dr. Danielle Davis, Ph.D. I’m a Certified SymptoPro Natural Family Planning Instructor with advanced training in women’s health and fertility education. I also hold certifications as a Women’s Holistic Hormone Health Practitioner, Childbirth Educator, Doula, and Thompson Method Breastfeeding Professional and I have the honor of working with women and couples to learn the SymptoPro method of Natural Family Planning—not only to achieve or avoid pregnancy, but to use charting as a powerful tool for understanding the body. Your cycle is a vital sign, and through personalized instruction, I help clients recognize what their charts may be revealing about their hormonal health, fertility patterns, and overall wellness. With an evidence-based approach, I guide clients through all stages of their reproductive years—from delaying pregnancy through preconception to postpartum and beyond—with compassion, education, and support. Additionally, I have a unique specialization in supporting women who are trying to conceive through infertility or after loss. After being diagnosed with PCOS at 16, I was told I may never be able to have children. Yet through the gift of charting and targeted supplements/lifestyle changes, my husband and I conceived on our second try. In April 2024, our firstborn son Lennon was born—but passed away unexpectedly at just 3 days old. His life and loss deeply shaped my calling and perspective. Now, I walk with many women who are navigating the grief, uncertainty, and hope that often accompany TTC after loss or infertility—offering not only practical charting support but a safe and compassionate space to be seen and understood. As someone who has journeyed through infertility and loss, I am honored to offer a unique perspective and trauma-informed approach to fertility education to women and couples who have experienced this pain, too. Natural Family Planning has been such a blessing in my marriage and life and I look forward to being part of your NFP journey!

So finally, after the birth of her daughter, she signed up and received instruction from a Symptopro Fertility Course—fell in love with the method—signed up to become an NFP instructor—and never looked back. Her Natural Fertility Health practice is based in the Greater Atlanta area, however, she serves individuals and couples around the United States. In addition to being a Symptopro Instructor (in-training), Dr. White is also a Certified Health Coach, Certified Mercier Therapy Fertility Specialist, Certified Barre Instructor, Certified Dry Needling Specialist and Peristeam Facilitator. Her rounded skill set in natural fertility education and pelvic rehabilitation is the perfect combination for total body healing.

He entered the field of mental health after spending over a decade in seminary formation discerning the priesthood. Joseph sees counseling as a form of accompaniment through the inevitable personal and interpersonal challenges of life. Joseph’s clinical training largely focused on addressing the core wounds that negatively impact one’s life. As a former NFP skeptic, I’m SO glad I took a leap of faith to learn the science behind NFP years ago. My hope is that anyone else wondering whether it really works can feel confident that YES! it DOES, and will decide to learn NFP themselves. Now it's your turn. I invite you to email me and get started on your journey. You're in great hands with SymptoPro. Let's do this together - you are not alone."

providers.name: Sofiya Ostap
providers.title: SymptoPro Instructor
providers.bio: Hi , My name is Sofiya and I am from Ukraine, Natural family planning has been a way of life and not just family planning method for me over the past 16 years of our marriage. God blessed us with 3 children: 2 girls and a boy. I decided to become an instructor to make this method more known, to assist and inspire couples who want to live and love in harmony with their body and their Creator. Our fertility and sex hormones are as important as any other system of our body and good balance in that area is good for our whole body. I'm amazed by the intricate way how our body works. Practicing NFP is decoding our body and signs it gives about our fertility status. NFP is a science, as it is based upon decades of scientific research, but it is also a faith, as it respects, accepts, and appreciates fertility as a gift from God. The cyclical nature of women's fertility gives couples the perfect opportunity to plan their family by observing, charting, and figuring out fertile time, abstaining during that time if wishing to avoid pregnancy or using that time to have the highest chances to conceive. Practicing NFP requires mutual agreement, cooperation and communication. I'd be happy to assist you in learning more about your fertility and help you through different stages and transitions.
